title: Qol Anything
description: this is quality of life mod while also adding other stuff that i just wanted to add. this is ingeneral just a basic simple mod that i make for myself and some friends.
body:
Qol Anything - Quality of life Anything It's a mod that adds recipes either from newer versions or self created as well some content that is themed around the popular media created figure "Gubby"

As of currently there are 7 added recipes for already existing items of the game, and 2 utility tools You can obtain and use for yourself.
 
The following recipes:
Gunpoweder recipe: brewing stand needed glowstone dust as the top slot and 1-3 charcoal below.  (requires blaze powder) 
Bundle recipe: 1 string and 1 leather. (taken from a newer version)
Saddle recipe: 3 leather 1 iron ingot. (taken from a newer version)
Name Tag recipe: 1 stick 1 paper 4 iron nuggets. 
Alternative lead recipe: 4 string 1 leather.
Enchanted Golden Apple recipe: 8 gold blocks 1 apple. (taken from a now deleted recipe from a older version)

Gubby side: there are gubby blocks (which you'll need a lot of) they generate in the following biomes: Cherry groves, Snowy plans, Snowy taigas, Snowy beachs, Snowy slopes, Ice spikes, Dripstone caves, Badlands, Eroded Badlands, Wooded Badlands, and Lush Caves. you can use these block for 2 things iron, and getting yourself a gubby.
Iron making: you make a alloy by cooking it the more you get the higher tier you can make until you are able to get iron nuggets by cooking iron alloy tier 3. (Just a Alternative for making iron) 
Getting a Gubby: you'll need to get a villager and make a block called "gubbycare" that will give the villager a profession called "Gubbycaretaker" and you will need a lot iron alloy tier 1's + iron alloy tier 2's to trade for a "Ghard" with Ghards you are able then go for the Gubby trade which will cost you a few iron blocks, and some Ghards  once traded for you have a Gubby.

Gubby (tool/utility): gained by a "Gubbycaretaker" (check above on how to get) when holding in main hand you get speed 3, jump boost 4, reistance 1, at the cost of having hunger 4. you can also make it in to a rabbit spawn egg via crafting. (i don't know why you would but you can) You can make a stronger version called "Strong gubby"

Strong Gubby (tool/utility): It's recipe is 1 gubby 6 tier 3 iron alloys and 2 iron blocks this stronger version now does 6+ attack damage, all effects last longer when no longer holding it (including hunger) and 1 extra level of resistance is added. 

note: anyone who plays this i want you to know that this is a basic simple mod and should not be taken seriously it's made and 100% personalized to my liking.
